metadata.task: memory-loop-audit task 5.1 refill: re-run set for the 40 windows (of the original 47-window full run) whose claude -p calls silently failed due to a sustained stale-credential outage starting at full-run window 8 (20:36:55) and continuing through window 47 -- confirmed via full_run_status.json (cumulative_cost_usd frozen at $14.3204077 across all of windows 8-47) and full_run.log timestamps
metadata.incident: Windows 1-7 of the original 47-window full run succeeded normally (real detection, real moments; preserved as-is in full-run-moments.jsonl / full-run-transcript-events.jsonl, NOT touched by this refill). Starting at window 8, every claude -p call exhausted its retry budget due to stale Claude Code keychain credentials (a genuine login-session expiry fixed by a human `/login`), but the driver logged each as a normal '0 moments' result instead of a hard error, so this went undetected for ~4 hours across all 40 remaining windows. Part 1 of this refill hardens audit_moments.py (_run_claude_p / detect_moments / judge_moment) to raise audit_moments.ExhaustedRetriesError instead, and the refill driver halts the entire run on first occurrence rather than silently continuing.
metadata.source_files_lost: 22 of the 40 failed windows' SOURCE TRANSCRIPT FILES have since been deleted by Claude Code's own session-log retention (~1-2 days after original sampling; confirmed via direct os.path.isfile re-check against every one of full-run-sample.json's windows 8-47, not trusted from any prior partial list). 18 of the 40 survive.
metadata.unplanned_finding: Beyond the per-window losses, the ENTIRE local transcript corpora for two repos have been purged since original sampling: -Users-joe-repos-personal-targ now has 0 .jsonl files under ~/.claude/projects/ (confirmed via `find ... -name '*.jsonl' | wc -l` => 0), and -Users-joe-repos-personal-pi-vim-mode's project directory no longer exists at all. This matches (and explains) why ALL 12 targ-sourced and ALL 4 pi-vim-mode-sourced windows in the gone-list came up missing -- it was not a coincidental cluster, it was two full-repo purges. Their combined 16-window replacement quota was redistributed to engram (+8) and phone-llm (+8), the two other repos originally weighted equally to targ (16 each in corpus.json's per_repo_targets), to avoid concentrating replacement volume in the small remaining repos (llmcpp/dotfiles/local-llm-optimization/Users-joe) and re-creating the single-repo skew risk documented in design.md D-A / vault note feedback_verify_mined_corpus_is_representative.
metadata.fork_scarcity_finding: Using extract.py's real determine_dispatch_type() classifier (not the looser content-keyword heuristic corpus.json's original dispatch_type_sample used), only 3 true 'fork' transcripts (subagent_type==fork, confirmed via .meta.json) remain anywhere in the unused corpus across all repos (engram: 1, phone-llm: 2, llmcpp: 0). All 3 were used in this replacement set. Where a lost window's expected_dispatch_type was 'fork' and no true-fork file remained, a fresh-context subagent was substituted instead (honestly labeled 'fresh' in expected_dispatch_type, not mislabeled as fork) -- each such substitution is called out explicitly in that entry's rationale.
metadata.excluded_paths_note: all 13 pilot-sample.json paths + all 47 full-run-sample.json paths (survivors AND gone) were excluded from replacement selection
